title: Memory Architecture
use_cases: Configure when managing immediate conversational flow and task state transitions
Implement when persisting past user interactions into a searchable vector database
Use when building structured entity relationship models within a knowledge graph architecture
Use when designing agentic workflows that require human-like cognitive memory tiers
content:
DuraGraph implements a hierarchical memory system inspired by human cognition: ``` block-beta columns 1 block:L1 A["L1: Working Memory
Active conversation · Immediate task state"] end block:L2 B["L2: Episodic Memory
Past conversations · Stored in vector database"] end block:L3 C["L3: Semantic Memory
Entity relationships · Stored in knowledge graph"] end L1 --> L2 L2 --> L3 ```
